# Soft Hyperobjects

Owns parametric garment, block, notion and technique cartridges. Fashion Cabinet owns the fc drafting kernel and platform; hyperobjects-spec owns shared schemas and validators. Printable solid counterparts belong to solid-hyperobjects.

Read README.md for setup and AGENTS.md for operating instructions.
Related contracts in other repositories (the keystone's fc-spec and ho-bridge, the solid commons, yantra4d's Fashion Cabinet consumers): README.md, section "Related repositories and contracts".
Entry points: README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, GOVERNANCE.md, cartridge main.py and project.json files.
See docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md for public/private data boundaries.
Verification commands and required external capabilities are defined in the
repository's CI and contributor documentation. Never infer a successful render
from schema conformance or from a skipped kernel-dependent check.
